data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was an overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000 (2013 GBP 17,262,000 positive) of which the major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse (2013 GBP 13,006,000 positive) together with a negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000 (2013 GBP 4,256,000 positive).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced adverse prioryear reserve development in 2014 totalling GBP 23.233m (net reported), representing a strengthening of reserves. The deterioration was primarily concentrated in third party liability and reinsurance acceptances, with worsened experience noted in general liability and professional indemnity classes. No gross prioryear movement figure was provided in the notes, only the net runoff amount.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year there was an overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000 (2013 GBP 17,262,000 positive) of which the major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse (2013 GBP 13,006,000 positive) together with a negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000 (2013 GBP 4,256,000 positive).

In previous years the Syndicate has benefitted from substantial back year releases but this year there was an adverse experience (2014 GBP 23,233,000 vs. 2013 GBP 17,262,000 positive) on claims on an annual accounting basis. This reflected worse than expected experience from the general liability and professional indemnity classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure available in the notes is reported as a 'net run-off' (net of reinsurance). No gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement table or claims development triangle was found in the report; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the net figure quoted in the notes and is flagged as net-derived. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities). No claims development triangle present.
